evidence: Analytic verification of no C4/C6 clique center lemma, exact B_v free pairs and threshold-3 join and graph rank formulas
correctness.rationale: The generalized quadrangle incidence graph is connected bipartite of girth eight and diameter four. Counting points, lines and incidences gives graph cycle rank b=(st)^2. Any Rips scale-2 clique lies in the unique relevant closed vertex neighborhood B_v: point/point and line/line distance-2 pairs have unique common neighbor (no C4), and triples with different pairwise centers would form prohibited C6. Descending free-face pairs S ⊂ N(v), |S|≥2, S∪{v} collapse R2 onto incidence graph R1. At scale 3 all cross-part point-line pairs become edges, while within each part threshold adjacency is exactly collinearity/concurrence. Thus R3 is join of their clique complexes, each a union of line/pencil simplices meeting in at most a vertex and collapsing onto a connected graph with b cycles. Join of wedge^b S1 with wedge^b S1 is wedge^(b^2) S3. R4 is full simplex by diameter four. Relative R1→R2 collapse and dimensions of stages determine all stated integral persistence bars. Checked quantifiers s,t>=2 and no assertion of realized parameters. Inspecting verifier W(2), W(3) confirms it only stress-tests the all-orders analytic argument rather than purporting to prove it.
